input_items.title: Federal Reserve holds rates steady, signals potential cut later this year
input_items.summary: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 4.25%-4.50% at the June 2026 meeting, citing sticky inflation but noting progress.

input_items.title: ECB warns inflation outlook remains uncertain amid geopolitical tensions
input_items.summary: European Central Bank officials expressed caution about the inflation trajectory, pointing to energy prices and trade disruptions.
